title: Hermite functions belong to finite-order spaces
statement: For every natural number $n$, multi-index $\alpha:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$, and exponent $p\in[0,\infty]$ with $p\ne\infty$, the Hermite function indexed by $\alpha$ belongs to $L^p$ for the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures.
